results.title: Introducing AgentGrid.io: one agent workspace for people and AI agents — AgentGrid
results.content:
AgentGrid.io is that shared place. It is an agent workspace where people and agents work on the same artifacts: documents, HTML reports, slides, React apps, and designs. Everyone stays on the same page while humans stay in control. You choose who gets access, and every touch is recorded for visibility.

We are launching AgentGrid.io today, and it is free to use.

Try telling your agent: "Share this document with me on AgentGrid.io." Your agent will figure it out.

## What is an agent workspace?

An agent workspace is a shared place where AI agents and people work on the same artifacts, instead of each agent producing output inside its own chat. It gives the work a stable address, an owner, a version history, and access rules that people control. [...] From there we are building toward a system of record for human-and-agent work: an external agent connects and refines an artifact, a human inspects and understands what changed, another person or agent continues from the same source, and finished work is shared without losing its identity or history. We will build this in the open and stay honest about what exists today versus what we are working toward.

## FAQ

### Which AI agents can connect to AgentGrid.io?

Any assistant that speaks MCP, including Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Hermes and OpenClaw. You bring the agent that fits the job rather than committing to one ecosystem.

### Is AgentGrid.io free?

Yes. AgentGrid.io is free to use at launch.

# Introducing AgentGrid.io: one agent workspace for people and AI agents

The AgentGrid team · 7 MIN READ

AI agents are becoming team members, but the systems around them are still human-first.

Your ChatGPT, your team member's Claude, your cloud Hermes, OpenClaw, or Claude Tag: they all need to collaborate on the same documents and apps. Agents should not have to pass work through disconnected chats, local files, and copy-paste handoffs. They need a shared place to work with us, humans.

results.title: AgentGrid.io: Shared workspace for humans and agents | Product Hunt
results.content:
What do you think? …

Avishay Cohen

Hey PH 👋

Avishay here, co-founder of Anima, makers of AgentGrid.io.  
Today, we're launching AgentGrid.io, a shared drive for humans and AI agents to collaborate on documents, websites, apps, and designs. Feels like Google Drive for humans, Git for agents.  
  
Bring your own AI agents. Keep your work independent of any AI provider.   
Everyone works on the same live artifacts.

What you can do with AgentGrid:

Collaborate on documents - Google Docs-like multiplayer editing for humans, with a Markdown and Git interface for agents.

Share/publish websites and apps - HTML/React apps are a new type of document - reports, slides, designs, internal apps - Share them securely or publish to the web, simply by asking your chat/agent. [...] Multi-agent-human collab - Let Claude create a report, ChatGPT improve it, Grok Bot generate visuals, and a teammate edit it manually. All on the same artifact.

Share AI work securely - Give every document, report, app, or design a persistent link and structured storage, instead of leaving it buried in a chat.

Version history and control - See who changed what, restore previous versions, and control what each agent can access or modify.

Agent-agnostic, made for all agents - Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Grok Bot, Cursor, Hermes, OpenClaw, and others via MCP, CLI, and APIs.

Bring your existing work - Import files, websites, and Figma designs to continue working with your agents. You can also ask your agents to simply put their work on AgentGrid.io.

Who it's for: [...] Who it's for:

Anyone creating real work with AI.

Founders, builders, designers, developers, marketers, product teams, agencies, and companies bringing AI agents into their daily workflows.

AgentGrid.io is Free to start: Unlimited agent seats.

Try it with your existing Claude, Grok Bot, or ChatGPT. Connect AgentGrid and ask:  
"Share this with me on AgentGrid.io."  
  
Why we built AgentGrid.io:  
Since the launch of OpenClaw and Hermes, we've been working alongside AI agents across Marketing, Engineering, BI, QA, CS, and more.

AI agents are not like humans, but they are becoming teammates we collaborate with, and we need an easy way to do that. We built AgentGrid for ourselves, and today we're opening it to everyone.

Teams can use the right AI agent for each task while keeping the work in one place and avoiding a lock-in to a single model provider.

People remain in control. Teams decide what each agent may see, edit, share, or publish. Agents’ access can be revoked, every change is attributed, and earlier versions can be restored.

“AI agents can create remarkable work, but that work needs somewhere durable and accountable to live,” said Avishay Cohen, co-founder and CEO of Anima. “AgentGrid.io gives teams one place to review, improve, and publish that work while keeping people in control.”
